content: Subscription will be automatically renewed on {{finalDate}} with updated pricing and specifications — {{price}}/month (Admins: {{adminsCount}} | {{perAdminPrice}} per admin)

comment.text: Informational text displayed below the payment details, informing the user about the automatic renewal of their subscription along with the updated pricing. `{{finalDate}}` is the renewal date, `{{price}}` is the total monthly price, `{{adminsCount}}` is the number of admins, and `{{perAdminPrice}}` is the price per admin.

usage.context:
<CommonTrans
 i18nKey="BusinessRenewalPricingInfo"
 values={{
 finalDate: paymentDate,
 price: formatPaymentCurrency(
 startValue * (currentTariffAdminsCount ?? 0),
 ),
 adminsCount: currentTariffAdminsCount ?? 0,
 perAdminPrice: formatPaymentCurrency(startValue),
 }}
 />
